# Venturally

> Investor- and lender-grade business plans built on a deterministic financial
> model. Every figure in every statement is computed by an engine, not written
> by a language model; every market claim carries a dated source; and the
> narrative is reconciled against the model before a plan can be exported.

## What it does

- Generates a complete business plan from a structured, business-model-aware intake.
- Builds three linked financial statements (P&L, cash flow, balance sheet) monthly
  across 60 periods, with the balance sheet asserted to balance in every period.
- Computes underwriter ratios: debt service coverage, current ratio, debt to
  equity, owner compensation, amortisation schedules, sources and uses.
- Sizes markets bottom-up with the arithmetic shown, cross-checked top-down, and
  cites every statistic with a retrievable, dated source.
- Reviews the plan against the rubric of its intended reader and blocks export on
  twelve failure conditions, including any figure in the prose that does not
  reconcile to the model.

## How it differs

- The AI proposes assumptions; a deterministic TypeScript engine computes every
  number that appears in a statement.
- Regulatory values (SBA DSCR thresholds, EB-5 investment minimums) are dated
  configuration with an effective-date range and a source, never constants.
- Industry benchmarks warn on out-of-band assumptions but never overwrite them.
- Every input driver is tagged known, estimated or benchmark-default, and that
  provenance is printed in the finished document.

## Pricing

- Draft: $0. Generate a complete plan and read every page. No card required.
- Plan: $199 one-time per finished plan. Unlocks PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint
  export, shareable links with read analytics, and the pitch deck. Permanent.
- Live: $39/month, optional. Actuals tracking, re-forecasting, monthly lender
  variance summaries. One-click cancellation.
- 30-day money-back guarantee on any payment.

## Segments

- Investor raise (pre-seed and seed)
- Immigration business plans (E-2, L-1A, EB-5) — document preparation only, not
  legal advice; review by licensed counsel is recommended before filing.

## Free tools

Seven ungated calculators running the same modules as the product, entirely in
the browser: loan amortisation, SBA 7(a) payment and eligibility, TAM/SAM/SOM,
debt service coverage, unit economics, break-even, and burn and runway.
